description: This file is a shell script containing test cases for verifying whitespace handling in Git diffs, including setup phases and multiple test scenarios involving 'git diff' and related commands.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success if commands run correctly.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects commands to fail.

methods.name: test_must_pass
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects commands to succeed.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test environment's internal clock to ensure time-ordering for Git commits.
